import{useEffect,useState}from'react';/**
 * useComponentInfo retrieves the list of components from the API.
 *
 * @param fromComponent The component requesting component info. Required for
 * determining the proper list of components from the context of a module.
 */export const useComponentInfo=(moduleID,isRemotecfg)=>{const[components,setComponents]=useState([]);useEffect(function(){const worker=async()=>{const infoPath=isRemotecfg?moduleID===''?'./api/v0/web/remotecfg/components':`./api/v0/web/remotecfg/modules/${moduleID}/components`:moduleID===''?'./api/v0/web/components':`./api/v0/web/modules/${moduleID}/components`;// Request is relative to the <base> tag inside of <head>.
const resp=await fetch(infoPath,{cache:'no-cache',credentials:'same-origin'});setComponents(await resp.json());};worker().catch(console.error);},[moduleID,isRemotecfg]);return[components,setComponents];};
